skins.content: Monster Hunter Collaboration Outfit/Camping Time, Meow! Tailored for the Rhodes Island Recon, who love moving through hills and woods—superbly mobile and breathable.

skins.quote: Masamune's latest hobby is developing new Bunny Dango recipes with Terran ingredients. As for the results—one look at Yoshitsune's face tells you everything.
